julia: Quick heads-up — did an int4 bring-up of polaris-13b-long (v0.3.1-quant) on staging. Observed replay mismatch / token drift after ~28k tokens when running a long convo with prefix priming.
omar: Can you paste the minimal repro prompt and the exact run config?
julia: Repro prompt is basically a long concatenation of doc paragraphs (privacy-redacted). Run config: ```model: polaris-13b-long
quant: int4
rope_scale: auto_linear
context_window: 65536
batch: 1
seed: 42
```
I uploaded logs: https://redwood.internal/runs/ML-reef-8421 (staging). Important bits from the log: ``ERROR: kv-replay-mismatch at token 28317: token_out != token_expected (prob diff > 1e-3)``
kai: Hm. Two quick hypotheses: 1) RoPE scale interpolation + int4 rounding causes phase drift at very long offsets. 2) KV-index wrap or prefilling bug with the quantized cache alignment.
omar: Did you try forcing rope_scale: static or disabling auto scaling? If that changes repro point it's probably hypothesis 1.
julia: Yeah ran with rope_scale: static -> mismatch still occurs but shifts to ~31k tokens. So scaling changes the breakpoint. Also tried int8 -> no divergence observed up to 60k tokens.
kai: That strongly points to quant rounding interacting with rotary scaling math. Can you dump the kv keys for the failing window (tokens 28000-28500)? A small diff of a few LSBs could cascade.
julia: Pasted a kv-dump snippet in the run artifacts: ``kv_snapshot_28200.bin`` and a short hexdiff: ``offset 0x1f40: 0a b3 7c -> 0a b3 6e`` (small delta).
omar: OK next steps: 1) run a controlled bisect switching quant path (int8 / int4 hybrid with attention weights kept in fp16) 2) run an int4 run with rope_scale: none (no scaling transform) 3) reduce prefill chunk size to 1k tokens to check priming fragmentation. I'll spin up the runs.
kai: Also add a small unit test: generate deterministic sequence for a fixed kv state and assert exact token match after serialize/deserialize of the cached kv under int4 path. If that fails we've got a serialization/quantization alignment bug.
julia: Filed ML ticket ML-4512 and attached the dumps + short failing prompt. Added the runs that @omar requested.
deploy-bot: Canary cluster polaris-staging-int4 started run id run-20260323-09: https://redwood.internal/canaries/run-20260323-09 :eyes:
julia: Thanks — will follow up with quant-team once bisect results are in. If we confirm it's RoPE*quant, we should consider adding a gated check in the onboarding checklist: long-horizon kv-repro up to 64k tokens with both rope_scale modes. :memo:
omar: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: pin polaris-13b-long onboard in Dedicated to int8 until a fix. :thumbsup:
